blurb.en: The everyday list methods in one place: add at the end, in the middle or several at once, take items out by position or by value, and ask where something is.
blurb.zh: 日常用的列表方法都在这里：加在末尾、插在中间、一次加好几个；按位置或按值取出删掉；问某样东西在哪。

en: append adds one item to the end. insert(position, value) puts one item in front of whatever is at that position now, so everything from there on moves one place along. extend adds every item of another list, one at a time. The difference between append and extend matters: append given a list adds that whole list as one single item, which is why pair in the demo ends up with length 2 and a list inside it.

pop removes an item and hands it back, so the result can be stored: with no argument it takes the last item, with an index it takes the item at that position. remove(value) looks for a value rather than a position and deletes only the first match - the demo appends a second Bob, and remove takes out the one that was already there. del names[i] deletes by position and gives nothing back.

index(value) gives the position of the first match, and in gives True or False without any error. Asking pop for an item from an empty list raises IndexError; the demo catches it and prints only the name of the exception type. (remove and index raise ValueError when the value is not in the list.)
All of these change the list itself. Apart from pop and index they give back None, so they are written as statements on their own line, never as names = names.append(...).
zh: append 把一项加到末尾。insert(位置, 值) 把一项放到该位置当前那一项的前面，从那里起的每一项都往后挪一格。extend 把另一个列表的每一项逐个加进来。append 与 extend 的区别要紧：append 收到一个列表，会把整个列表当作一项加进去——所以演示里的 pair 长度是 2，里面套着一个列表。
pop 删掉一项并把它交回来，所以结果可以存下来：不带实参取最后一项，带下标取那个位置的一项。remove(值) 找的是值而不是位置，而且只删第一个匹配的——演示里又 append 了一个 Bob，remove 删掉的是原来就在的那一个。del names[i] 按位置删，什么都不交回。
index(值) 给出第一个匹配的位置；in 给出 True 或 False，不会报错。对空列表 pop 会抛 IndexError；演示接住它，只打印异常类型的名字。（值不在列表里时，remove 与 index 抛的是 ValueError。）
这些方法改动的都是列表本身。除了 pop 和 index，它们交回的都是 None，所以单独占一行当语句写，绝不写成 names = names.append(...)。

lineNotes.en: append given a list: the whole list becomes one item, so pair has two items, not three.
lineNotes.zh: append 收到一个列表：整个列表成为一项，所以 pair 有两项，不是三项。

lineNotes.en: Deletes only the first Bob - the one that has been there since the start; the Bob just appended stays.
lineNotes.zh: 只删第一个 Bob——一开始就在的那个；刚 append 进来的 Bob 留着。

blurb.en: A slice on the left of = replaces a whole stretch of a list, and the new stretch does not have to be the same length.
blurb.zh: 写在等号左边的切片会替换列表里的一整段，而且新的一段不必一样长。

en: Assigning to a slice replaces every item in that stretch with the items of the list on the right. The two lengths need not match: the first assignment swaps two items for three, so the list grows from five items to six.

A slice whose start and stop are the same index covers no items at all, so assigning to it inserts without replacing anything. del with a slice removes a whole stretch in one go, and a step in the slice picks out every second item, every third, and so on.

A slice with both ends left empty, on the left of =, means the whole of the list that a already names: its contents are replaced, but it is still the same list object, so the other name b sees the change and a is b stays True. A plain assignment to a instead makes the name point at a brand-new list; b keeps the old one, and a is b becomes False.
zh: 给切片赋值，会把那一段里的每一项换成右边列表里的各项。两边长度不必相等：第一次赋值把两项换成三项，列表从五项变成六项。
起点和终点是同一个下标的切片一项都不包含，所以给它赋值就是插入，什么都不替换。del 加切片一次删掉一整段；切片里带上步长，就能挑出每隔一项、每隔两项……
两端都留空的切片写在等号左边，指的是 a 已经指着的那个列表的全部：内容换掉了，但仍是同一个列表对象，所以另一个名字 b 看得见变化，a is b 仍是 True。直接给 a 赋值则是让这个名字指向一个全新的列表；b 留着旧的那个，a is b 变成 False。

lineNotes.en: From here on a and b are two names for one list.
lineNotes.zh: 从这里起，a 和 b 是同一个列表的两个名字。

lineNotes.en: Rebinding: a now names a new list, and b still names the old one.
lineNotes.zh: 重新绑定：a 现在指向一个新列表，b 还指着旧的那个。

title.en: Copying a List: Just Another Name
title.zh: 拷贝列表：只是多一个名字

blurb.en: Assigning a list to a second name copies nothing: both names share one list, and a change through either name shows up through both.
blurb.zh: 把列表赋给另一个名字什么也不复制：两个名字共用一个列表，从哪个名字改，另一个都看得见。

en: An assignment never copies an object. The line after a is built makes b a second name for the very same list. is checks exactly that - whether two names refer to one object - and here b is a is True.

So every change made through b - setting a cell of the first row, appending a new row - is a change to the one list there is: afterwards a holds [[99, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6]], exactly like b. The inner lists are the same objects too: b[0] is a[0] is True.
The three programs on copying a list run the same steps - change b, then check whether a changed too. "Copying a List: Shallow Copy" and "Copying a List: Deep Copy" do it with real copies.
zh: 赋值从不复制对象。建好 a 之后的那一行，只是让 b 成为同一个列表的第二个名字。is 查的正是这件事——两个名字是否指着同一个对象——这里 b is a 是 True。
所以通过 b 做的每一处改动——改第一行的一格、追加一行——都是对唯一那个列表的改动：改完之后 a 与 b 一样，都是 [[99, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6]]。里面的各行也是同一批对象：b[0] is a[0] 是 True。
讲拷贝列表的三个程序做的是同一组操作——改 b，再查 a 跟着变了没有。「拷贝列表：浅拷贝」与「拷贝列表：深拷贝」用真正的副本来做。

lineNotes.en: Appends to the only list there is, so a gets the new row as well.
lineNotes.zh: 追加到唯一的那个列表上，所以 a 也多了这一行。

blurb.en: A copy of the outer list is a new list - but the rows inside it are still shared with the original.
blurb.zh: 复制出来的外层列表是新的——可里面的各行仍与原列表共用。

en: There are three everyday ways to copy a list: a slice with both ends left empty, passing the list to list(), and the list's own copy method. All three build a new outer list, so b is a is False, and appending a row to b leaves a with its two rows. The last two lines of the demo check all three ways.

They are shallow copies: the new outer list is filled with the same inner objects the old one held. b[0] and a[0] are one list, so setting a cell through b sets it in a as well - the 99 turns up in both.

For a list of numbers or strings a shallow copy is all you need, because numbers and strings cannot be changed in place. It is a list of lists - a grid, a table - where the shared rows bite. "Copying a List: Deep Copy" runs the same steps and shares nothing.
zh: 复制列表日常有三种写法：两端都留空的切片、把列表交给 list()、列表自己的复制方法。三种都造出一个新的外层列表，所以 b is a 是 False，给 b 追加一行，a 仍是原来那两行。演示的最后两行把三种写法都查了一遍。
它们都是浅拷贝：新的外层列表里装的是旧列表原来那批内层对象。b[0] 和 a[0] 是同一个列表，所以通过 b 改一格，a 里也改了——99 两边都出现。
列表里装的是数或字符串时，浅拷贝就够了，因为数和字符串没法就地修改。咬人的是列表的列表——网格、表格——里共用的那些行。「拷贝列表：深拷贝」做同一组操作，什么都不共用。

lineNotes.at: print(a[:] is a, list(a) is a, a.copy() is a)
lineNotes.en: Three ways to copy, and each one gives a new outer list.
lineNotes.zh: 三种复制写法，每一种都给出一个新的外层列表。

lineNotes.en: Equal in value, yet the first row inside the copy is still the original row object.
lineNotes.zh: 值相等；而副本里的第一行仍是原来那个行对象。

run.expect:
[[99, 2], [3, 4]]
[[99, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6]]
False True
False False False
True True

blurb.en: A deep copy rebuilds the lists inside as well, so the copy and the original share nothing at all.
blurb.zh: 深拷贝连里面的列表也重新造一份，副本与原列表什么都不共用。

en: deepcopy, from the standard copy module, copies an object and then everything inside it, however deeply nested. The steps are exactly those of the other two programs on copying a list, and this time a comes out unchanged: the 99 and the new row exist only in b.

Both is tests are False: the outer list and every row are new objects. The price is time and memory, since every nested object is duplicated, so it is the tool for when the inner objects can themselves be changed, as the rows of a grid can.
Importing the whole module and writing its name in front of the function keeps it obvious where deepcopy comes from. The same module also has copy.copy, which makes a shallow copy.
zh: deepcopy 来自标准库的 copy 模块：它复制一个对象，再把里面的一切都复制一遍，嵌套多深都一样。操作步骤与另两个讲拷贝列表的程序完全相同，这一次 a 毫发无损：99 和新的一行只在 b 里。
两个 is 都是 False：外层列表与每一行都是新对象。代价是时间与内存——每个嵌套对象都复制了一份——所以它用在内层对象自己也能被修改的时候，比如网格的各行。
导入整个模块、调用时把模块名写在函数前面，deepcopy 从哪里来就一目了然。同一个模块里还有 copy.copy，做的是浅拷贝。

lineNotes.en: Changes the copy's own first row; a still has its original row.
lineNotes.zh: 改的是副本自己的第一行；a 仍是它原来那一行。

title.en: A Grid Whose Rows Are One List
title.zh: 三行其实是同一行的网格

blurb.en: Multiplying a list of one row looks like building a grid, but every row is the same list - set one cell and the whole column changes.
blurb.zh: 把「装着一行的列表」乘几次，看上去造了一张网格，其实每一行都是同一个列表——改一格，整列都变。

en: * on a list repeats the references it holds; it never copies the objects they refer to. Repeating [0] is harmless, because the number 0 cannot be changed in place. But multiplying a list that holds a row repeats the reference to that one row, so all the rows are the same list object.
That is why setting the first cell of the first row of the shared grid puts a 1 at the start of every row, and why bad[0] is bad[1] is True.
A list comprehension works its expression out afresh on every pass, so each row is a brand-new list and good[0] is good[1] is False. That is the usual way to build a grid in Python.
zh: 列表上的 * 重复的是它装着的引用，从不复制引用所指的对象。把 [0] 重复几次无妨，因为数 0 没法就地修改。可是把「装着一行的列表」乘几次，重复的是指向那唯一一行的引用，于是所有的行都是同一个列表对象。
所以在共用行的网格里给第一行第一格赋值，每一行的开头都变成了 1，bad[0] is bad[1] 也是 True。
列表推导式每转一圈都重新计算它的表达式，所以每一行都是全新的列表，good[0] is good[1] 是 False。这是 Python 里造网格的通常写法。

lineNotes.en: Changes one cell of one row object - and in the shared grid that one row object is every row.
lineNotes.zh: 改的是一个行对象里的一格——而在共用行的网格里，那个行对象就是每一行。

blurb.en: Two nested index loops visit every cell of a table once, adding each value to its row total and to its column total.
blurb.zh: 两重下标循环把表里每一格走一遍，每个值既加进它那一行的合计，也加进它那一列的合计。

en: A 2D grid in Python is a list of rows, so grid[r][c] means row r first, then column c within that row. The number of rows is len(grid) and the number of columns is the length of a row - the first one here, so the grid must have at least one row.

The two totals lists start as zeros, one per row and one per column. The outer loop picks a row, the inner loop walks along it, and each cell is added to two totals: the one for its row and the one for its column.

The function returns both lists at once as a tuple, which the caller unpacks into two names. The demo also tries a 1 by 1 grid, a single row and a single column. The single row [1, 2, 3] has one row total and three column totals, ([6], [1, 2, 3]); the single column is the other way round, ([1, 2, 3], [6]) - a mix-up between rows and columns would swap the two lists.
zh: Python 里的二维网格是「行的列表」，所以 grid[r][c] 的意思是先取第 r 行、再取这一行里的第 c 列。行数是 len(grid)，列数是一行的长度——这里量的是第一行，所以网格至少要有一行。
两张合计表一开始都是 0，每行一个、每列一个。外层循环选一行，内层循环沿着这一行走，每一格加进两个合计：它那一行的，和它那一列的。
函数把两个列表作为一个元组一起交回，调用方把它拆进两个名字。演示还试了 1×1 的表、只有一行的表、只有一列的表。只有一行的 [1, 2, 3] 有一个行合计、三个列合计：([6], [1, 2, 3])；只有一列的正好反过来：([1, 2, 3], [6])——行与列一旦弄混，这两个列表就会对调。

lineNotes.en: Every row has the same length, so measuring the first one is enough.
lineNotes.zh: 每一行一样长，量第一行就够了。

title.zh: 矩阵乘法：三重下标循环

blurb.en: Each cell of the product is a row of a times a column of b, worked out with three nested index loops.
blurb.zh: 乘积的每一格是 a 的一行乘以 b 的一列，由三重下标循环算出来。

en: To multiply an m by n matrix a by an n by p matrix b, the number of columns of a must equal the number of rows of b, and the result has m rows and p columns. Cell (i, j) of the result is row i of a and column j of b multiplied item by item and added up.
The two outer loops choose the result cell. The innermost loop runs along the shared index k - across row i of a and down column j of b at the same time - adding one product per step.

The result table is built with a list comprehension so that every row is a separate list; building it with * on the outer list would make every row the same object (see "A Grid Whose Rows Are One List").
Matrix multiplication does not commute: the demo multiplies a 2 by 3 matrix by a 3 by 2 to get a 2 by 2, then the other way round to get a 3 by 3. A 1 by 3 times a 3 by 1 is a single cell.
zh: m×n 的矩阵 a 乘以 n×p 的矩阵 b：a 的列数必须等于 b 的行数，结果是 m 行 p 列。结果的第 (i, j) 格，是 a 的第 i 行与 b 的第 j 列逐项相乘再加起来。
外面两层循环选定结果的一格。最内层循环沿着两者共用的下标 k 走——同时横穿 a 的第 i 行、竖穿 b 的第 j 列——每走一步加一个乘积。
结果表用列表推导式建，每一行才是各自独立的列表；外层用 * 建的话，每一行都会是同一个对象（见「三行其实是同一行的网格」）。
矩阵乘法不满足交换律：演示先用 2×3 的矩阵乘 3×2 的，得到 2×2；反过来乘，得到 3×3。1×3 乘 3×1 只有一格。

lineNotes.en: n is the number of rows of b, which must equal the number of columns of a; the program trusts the caller on that.
lineNotes.zh: n 是 b 的行数，它必须等于 a 的列数；程序在这一点上信任调用方。

lineNotes.en: m separate rows of p zeros - one fresh list per row.
lineNotes.zh: m 个各自独立的行，每行 p 个 0——每一行都是新造的列表。

title.en: Matrix Multiply: Rows Times Columns with zip
title.zh: 矩阵乘法：zip 取列、行乘列

blurb.en: zip turns the rows of b into its columns; each cell of the product is then the dot product of a row of a and a column of b.
blurb.zh: zip 把 b 的各行变成它的各列；乘积的每一格，就是 a 的一行与 b 的一列的点积。

en: The dot product of two sequences of the same length multiplies them position by position and adds up the products; zip does the pairing. A cell of the matrix product is the dot product of a row of a with a column of b, so once the columns of b are at hand, the whole product is two nested comprehensions.

zip with a star in front of b takes the columns: the star spreads the rows of b out as separate arguments, and zip then groups their first items, their second items, and so on. For the b in the demo, the columns come out as tuples: (7, 9, 11) and (8, 10, 12).

zip hands back an iterator, which can be gone through only once. Every row of a needs all the columns again, so they are put into a list first; without that, only the first row of the result would be filled, and every later row would come out empty.
"Matrix Multiply: Three Index Loops" gets identical results by indexing every cell explicitly.
zh: 两个等长序列的点积：逐个位置相乘，再把乘积加起来；配对由 zip 完成。矩阵乘积的一格是 a 的一行与 b 的一列的点积，所以只要手里有了 b 的各列，整个乘积就是两层嵌套的推导式。
b 前面加一个星号交给 zip，取出的就是各列：星号把 b 的每一行拆成一个单独的实参，zip 再把它们的第一项归成一组、第二项归成一组……对演示里的 b，取出的各列是两个元组：(7, 9, 11) 与 (8, 10, 12)。
zip 交回的是迭代器，只能走一遍。a 的每一行都要把所有列再用一次，所以先把它们放进一个列表；不这样做，结果只有第一行有内容，后面每一行都是空的。
「矩阵乘法：三重下标循环」逐格用下标计算，结果完全相同。

lineNotes.en: A small helper with one job keeps the comprehension below readable.
lineNotes.zh: 只做一件事的小帮手函数，让下面的推导式好读。

blurb.en: Rotating left by k is two slices joined the other way round: from k to the end, then the start up to k.
blurb.zh: 左旋 k 位就是两段切片倒过来接：先是从 k 到末尾，再是开头到 k 之前。

en: Rotating a list left by k moves the first k items to the back, keeping their order. Two slices do it in one expression: everything from index k onwards, followed by everything before index k. Slicing and + both build new lists, so the caller's list is never changed - after all four calls, days is still Mon to Fri in order.

Reducing k modulo the length first means that rotating a five-item list by 7 is the same as rotating it by 2, and a negative k turns into a rotation to the right (-1 moves the last item to the front). It also keeps k inside the list; without it, a k larger than the length would give the list back unrotated.
The empty list needs a check of its own, because the modulo would divide by zero. "Rotate a List: pop and append" does the same job one step at a time.
zh: 把列表左旋 k 位，就是把前 k 项按原顺序挪到后面。两段切片一个表达式就能做到：下标 k 起的全部，后面接上下标 k 之前的全部。切片和 + 都造新列表，所以调用方的列表从不改变——四次调用之后，days 仍是 Mon 到 Fri 的原顺序。
先让 k 对长度取余：五项的列表旋转 7 位与旋转 2 位是一回事，负的 k 则变成向右旋转（-1 把最后一项挪到最前）。取余也让 k 落在列表之内；不取余的话，k 比长度大时，列表会原样交回、根本没转。
空列表要单独挡住，因为取余会除以零。「列表旋转：pop 再 append」一步一步地做同一件事。

lineNotes.en: A new empty list, not items itself: the function always hands back a list of its own.
lineNotes.zh: 交回一个新的空列表，而不是 items 本身：这个函数交回的总是它自己造的列表。

title.en: Rotate a List: pop and append

blurb.en: One step of rotation is: take the first item off and put it on the end. Repeat it k times - on a copy, not on the caller's list.
blurb.zh: 旋转一步就是：把第一项拿下来、放到末尾。重复 k 次——在副本上做，不动调用方的列表。

en: pop(0) removes and returns the first item and append puts it on the end: one step of a left rotation, and k steps rotate by k. Reducing k modulo the length first skips whole turns, which would only bring the list back to where it started, and turns a negative k into the matching rotation to the right.

pop and append change the list they are called on. Working on the caller's list would rotate it for them - a side effect nobody asked for - so the function first makes its own copy and changes only that. After all four calls, days is still Mon to Fri in order.
pop(0) has to shift every remaining item one place to the left, so this version does more work than "Rotate a List: Two Slices" when k is large; both give the same answer for every input.
zh: pop(0) 删掉并交回第一项，append 把它放到末尾：这是左旋的一步，做 k 步就旋转 k 位。先让 k 对长度取余，省掉整圈——转整圈只会回到原样——也把负的 k 变成对应的向右旋转。
pop 与 append 改动的是调用它们的那个列表。直接在调用方的列表上做，就会替人家把列表转了——一个谁也没要的副作用——所以函数先做一份自己的副本，只改副本。四次调用之后，days 仍是 Mon 到 Fri 的原顺序。
pop(0) 要把剩下的每一项都往左挪一格，所以 k 大的时候，这个版本比「列表旋转：两段切片」多做不少事；两者对任何输入给出的答案都相同。

lineNotes.en: Same guard as with slices: the modulo below would divide by zero.
lineNotes.zh: 与切片版同样的守卫：下面的取余会除以零。

lineNotes.en: result is the empty copy, so the caller gets a new empty list, not their own.
lineNotes.zh: result 是那份空的副本，调用方拿到的是一个新的空列表，不是他自己那个。

blurb.en: Removing from a list while a for loop walks over it makes the loop skip items; loop over a copy instead, or build a new list.
blurb.zh: 一边用 for 遍历列表、一边从中删除，循环会跳过元素；改成遍历副本，或者另建一个新列表。

en: A for loop over a list keeps an internal position counter. When remove deletes the current item, everything after it shifts one place to the left, so the item that came next is now at the current position - and the counter moves on past it. In the demo, -1 is removed and -2 slides into its place unseen; the same happens to -5 and -6.

The first fix still removes from the list it was given, but loops over a copy of it, so the positions the loop is counting never move. The second fix, drop_negatives, removes nothing at all: it builds a new list of the items to keep and leaves the original alone - after the call, data still holds all seven numbers, negatives included.

Building a new list is usually the clearer choice, and it is the only one of the three functions that does not change its argument. The broken version is kept on purpose, and the demo hands it a copy of data so that data itself survives.
zh: for 遍历列表时，内部记着一个位置计数。remove 删掉当前这一项后，它后面的每一项都往左挪一格，原本排在下一个的那项就落到了当前位置——而计数照样往前走，把它跳了过去。演示里 -1 被删掉，-2 滑到它的位置上、没被看到；-5 和 -6 也是这样。
第一种修法仍然从传进来的列表里删，但遍历的是它的一份副本，所以循环数着的那些位置不会移动。第二种修法 drop_negatives 什么都不删：它另建一个新列表，放进要留下的项，原列表不动——调用之后，data 仍是原来那七个数，负数一个不少。
另建新列表通常更清楚，而且三个函数里只有它不改动自己的实参。坏掉的那个版本是故意留着的，演示交给它的是 data 的副本，data 本身才得以保全。

lineNotes.en: Broken on purpose: each time it removes an item, it skips the one right after it.
lineNotes.zh: 故意写坏的：每删掉一项，就跳过紧跟在它后面的那一项。

lineNotes.en: A new list: the items to keep go here, and numbers is only read.
lineNotes.zh: 一个新列表：要留下的项放进这里，numbers 只读不改。
